adapterId.description: The adapter id uniquely identifies an adapter instance.
adapterId.label: Adapter Id

metrics.description: Snapshot of the metrics object for this adapter instance (`valueAccessor` adapter_metrics). The active adapter is pinned under adapter_id_anchor_lock, the shared counters are copied outside the lock into the caller pool, and the pin is released after the copy. `additional` is produced by the adapter type's get_additional_metrics and must not refer to the adapter after that call returns. The adapter's own pool still sees the live object. NULL when no active instance.
metrics.label: Metrics

properties.description: Snapshot of selected conf properties plus runtime properties for this adapter instance (`valueAccessor` adapter_properties). The pointer is loaded under adapter_id_anchor_lock, the adapter is referenced across the copy into the caller pool, and the reference is released after the copy. The adapter's own pool still sees the live object. Typically absent on the active anchor after full stop.
properties.label: Properties

referenceCount.description: Active instance reference count, copied under adapter_id_anchor_lock (valueAccessor adapter_reference_count). Safe scalar snapshot for admin/debug.
referenceCount.label: Reference Count

serviceId.brief: The id of the associated service
serviceId.description: The id of the associated service. The URI of the service is '/afw/_AdaptiveService_/' followed by this id.
serviceId.label: Service Id

stopping.description: Reference counts of stopping instances, snapshotted under adapter_id_anchor_lock (valueAccessor stopping_adapter_instances).
stopping.label: Stopping Instances
